Name: JojaGrowth Fertilizer
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=4]"I always use [b][color=#6d9eeb]Joja [/color][/b]fertilizer. It makes my crops stronger and healthier." -Andy, Stardew Valley Expanded[/size][/quote]
JojaMart now stocks [b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/color][/b]!

[b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/color][/b][/b]
﻿﻿- Sold in the bin [b]at the back[/b] of [b]JojaMart[/b].
﻿﻿- Increases your crop growth speed by [b]up to 50%[/b]! ...[b]sorta[/b]. [i]Actually [/i]increases crop growth [b]randomly[/b], from a [b]1%[/b] to a [b]50%[/b] increase.
﻿﻿﻿- Good luck!

[b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaGrowth Premium Fertilizer[/color][/b][/b]
﻿﻿- Sold in the bin [b]at the back[/b] of [b]JojaMart[/b][b] if you've purchases a [color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color]Membership[/b].
﻿﻿- Increases soil quality [b]randomly[/b], from soil [b]level 0-2[/b]. So possibly not at all! Good luck!
﻿﻿- Increases your crop growth speed by [b]up to 30%[/b]! ...[b]sorta[/b]. [i]Actually [/i]increases crop growth [b]randomly[/b], from a [b]1%[/b] to a [b]30%[/b] increase.

Growth speed variation and soil level variation are both editable in the config. Soil quality level [b][i]can [/i][/b]range from 0-[b]3[/b], but a roll that lands on 3 is equivalent to Deluxe Fertilizer, and that seemed a bit strong for early game so I left it at 0-2.

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned goods, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38939]JojaMills Breakfast[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341]JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url]for more Joja snacks!

Or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job![b]

Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher

(Used in Screenshots: Stardew Valley Expanded, Peachy Objects, Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, VPR-Inspired UI)
